approval_scope: Accurate source-bound authority, proposal, evidence-boundary and future-scope record only

findings.finding: The record binds the ordinary native source-driver route, native ConstructionBudget callback, shared reach work, eager read_glb accessor production and later cached POSITION selection. It does not falsely describe POSITION retrieval as fresh production.

The passive interval covers inspections through future seed inclusion and distinguishes optional prefix authority from stronger whole-scan or whole-request behavior. The original suffix and foreign first-exception obligations remain explicit.

The C057 colliding-dictionary-key witness is preserved as conditional source reasoning. Exact dictionary type, saved aliases and native class identity are not treated as sufficient authority; counts.get is included in the meter bootstrap problem.

Work external_check, captured observer, nested construction check, live operand cap, dispatch and relevant mutable storage remain explicit dependencies. Source-driver eligibility is not transferred to Agent callbacks.

A flag, receipt or epoch cannot authenticate itself. The proposal requires an independently grounded paid router, real producer provenance, actual alias ownership, complete invalidation coverage and separate adoption for changed host semantics.

Rejected, partial, interrupted and repeated work remains charged. Optional inspection exceptions are not silently converted to false predicates. Midscan fallback after omissions requires a separately proved continuation/replay design.

The eager prefix rejection is scoped to separately charged per-occurrence leaf checks and the specified three-check current-row credit. It is not presented as a universal lower bound, a measured request result or a ban on genuine producer-fact reuse.

OK-PROP-COLD-ADMISSION-068/0.1.0 remains explicitly unadopted. C069 is a finite source-only producer-to-reader ownership and paid-routing task; instrumentation requires both authority safety and positive complete-request funding.

Static derivation imports standard-library source/JSON/AST/hash tools only; no product imports or helper calls appear. Validation describes root executions and does not claim independent reviewer execution.

Historical recording failures, C035 hold, M1 rejection, C057 uncertainty, full reach acceptance, LFS migration and full product goal remain visible. C067 verification does not rewrite C066's historical recovery limitation.

caveats: Approval does not establish a safe router, actual receipt layout, passive host interval, complete request savings or an implementation.
